result.title: AirVT-15k: A Query-Diverse UAV Video-Text Dataset and Query-Adaptive Evidence Alignment Network for Retrieval
result.summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle video-text retrieval (UAV-TVR) requires matching language to both scene context and subtle object changes. A harbor-layout query relies on global scene context, whereas a departing-vessel query requires local functional cues and motion states. Existing benchmarks provide diverse aerial descriptions but give limited attention to distinct evidence needs within the same video. We introduce AirVT-15k, a benchmark of 15,504 UAV videos and 155,040 captions, with ten complementary bilingual captions per video describing scenes, object states, and temporal changes. We also propose AirFocus-CST, which selects query-relevant frames and patches, encodes temporal feature differences, and combines coarse-to-fine interaction (CFI) with optimal-transport alignment (OTA). Average mean recall reaches 63.67% on AirVT-15k and 24.41% on CapERA, improving over the strongest baselines by 2.96 and 1.91 percentage points, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://chenxi000233.github.io/AirVT-15k-site/.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 AirVT-15k 无人机视频-文本检索数据集，每个视频配十条覆盖场景、物体状态与时序变化的双语描述，并提出 AirFocus-CST，按查询选择相关帧与 patch、编码时序特征差异，结合由粗到细交互与最优传输对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 查询条件下的帧与 patch 筛选可对应 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与任务必要信息保留，可供核查其选择机制能否转为推理期的证据门控；但该文做的是检索对齐而非 latent 推理状态生成，联系仍需较多验证。
